issues.label: Wall roughness
issues.explanation: Fluent modifies the wall law using roughness height and constant. Kutta currently implements smooth-wall laws only, so roughness drag and y-plus cannot be reproduced. Adapter detail: inactive model flag retained; does not apply to the selected viscous model.

issues.label: k-epsilon model controls
issues.explanation: Fluent uses this switch or coefficient in the k-epsilon closure or its wall treatment. Kutta implements the standard model with standard wall functions and Fluent's default coefficients; other variants are not adapted. Adapter detail: inactive model flag retained; does not apply to the selected viscous model.

issues.label: Energy equation
issues.explanation: Fluent solves temperature or enthalpy. Kutta omits energy; it is decoupled from momentum only when all active density and viscosity laws are constant. Temperature results are unavailable. Adapter detail: energy ignored (decoupled): constant density and viscosity.

issues.label: Warped-face gradient correction
issues.explanation: Fluent corrects gradients for nonplanar faces. Kutta does not yet implement Fluent's warped-face correction and will run with WFGC off only when you opt in with --approximate wfgc. V6 CPU hybrid diagnostic versus Fluent: velocity L2 3.366748%, pressure L2 2.665514%, k L2 14.722368%, omega L2 2.805466%, pressure-drop error 1.973008%; combined solver discrepancy, not isolated WFGC error or a general bound.
